author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 우리나라에는 지금까지 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새로, 연안과 먼바다에서 지낸다. 바닷가나 하구에서는 늘 무리를 이루어 생활하며, 멸치 같은 작은 물고기와 오징어, 새우 같은 갑각류를 먹는다. 얕은 물가의 나무 위나 튀어나온 바위에 풀줄기를 높이 쌓아 둥지를 짓고 알을 1~3개 낳는다. 세계적으로는 온대 지역에 분포한다.

art.subject: Black Tern (Chlidonias niger), adult in breeding plumage, as on spring passage in May: head, neck, breast and belly sooty black, darkest on the head; undertail coverts white; mantle, back, scapulars, rump, tail and upperwing uniform medium grey, the outer primaries a shade darker; underwing pale grey, distinctly paler than the upperwing. Bill black, fine and straight; dark eye; legs short and dark red-brown.
art.pose: flying low over the sea with a flock
art.scene: Korean estuary opening onto the sea in May, terns hawking low over calm water under a clear sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (May), side view perched on a post: black head and bill, sooty-black breast and belly, white undertail coverts, uniform grey back, scapulars and wing coverts, wingtips beyond the short grey tail, short dark red legs
adult breeding plumage, in flight seen from below: black head and body contrasting with pale grey underwing, white undertail coverts, grey tail with a shallow fork
adult breeding plumage, in flight seen from above: uniform grey upperwing, mantle, rump and tail, the outer primaries slightly darker grey
art.build: Small, slim marsh tern, clearly smaller than Black-headed Gull, with a rounded head and a buoyant, dipping flight, picking food from the water surface rather than plunge-diving. Bill black, slender, about as long as the head. Legs very short, dark reddish. At rest the long wingtips project well beyond the tail. Tail short, grey, with a shallow fork. Non-breeding and juvenile birds are white on the forehead and underparts, with a black rear crown and ear patch and a dark grey patch on the side of the breast.
avoid: Do not paint white wing coverts, a white rump and tail, or black underwing coverts; those mark White-winged Tern (Chlidonias leucopterus).
Do not paint white cheeks on a grey body (Whiskered Tern, Chlidonias hybrida).
Do not paint the scapulars white; they are the same grey as the back.
Do not give it a red bill or long legs.
